welcome.title: Welcome to Echo Scribe
welcome.subtitle: Grant the permissions below, pick a speech model, then start dictating anywhere. Screen Recording is optional — only needed if you want meetings to capture the other person's audio.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.subtitle: Echo Scribe needs your microphone to capture what you say.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.subtitle: Required to paste transcribed text at the cursor in any app.

screenRecording.title: Screen Recording
screenRecording.subtitle: Lets Echo Scribe capture the other participant's audio during Zoom, Google Meet, and other meetings. Without it, only your microphone is recorded.

permissions.promptHint: Approve the macOS dialog that just appeared. If it didn’t show up, click “Grant access” again to open System Settings.

llmModel.title: Local AI model
llmModel.description: Powers the log-capture flow (auto-classifying notes, tasks, tags). Voice-at-cursor works without it — skip to come back later.
llmModel.skippedNote: Skipped. Log-capture will show a friendly notice until you pick a model in Settings.

dictationShortcut.title: Dictation shortcut
dictationShortcut.description: Press and hold to record. Default is Right Control — change it here if that conflicts with another app.

logCaptureShortcut.title: Log capture shortcut
logCaptureShortcut.description: Press and hold to capture a thought or task. Default is Right Option — Echo Scribe will classify it locally and pop a review overlay.

skipButton.label: Skip setup for now
skipButton.note: You can browse Echo Scribe now and finish setup later in Settings.

resetTcc.confirmBody: This wipes Microphone + Accessibility + Screen Recording grants, quits Echo Scribe, and reopens it automatically so you can re-grant access. Continue?
resetTcc.timeoutError: Reset returned but the app didn't quit. Try restarting manually.
